answer_2.quote: We evaluate QA performance through accuracy. For proofs, we introduce three metrics: (1) Node Accuracy (NA): Fraction of examples where the predicted node set matches exactly with the gold node set, (2) Edge Accuracy (EA): Fraction of examples where the predicted edge set match exactly with the gold set, and (3) Proof Accuracy (PA): Fraction of examples where the generated proof matches exactly with the gold proof. We also evaluate Full Accuracy (FA), denoting the fraction of samples where both the answer and the proof are exactly correct.
